expectations.text: The review flags the clickable div for search (not keyboard accessible, no role or name) and the icon-only delete button without an accessible name
expectations.evidence: The review says of line 4: "Keyboard users can't tab to it or trigger it with Enter or Space. It has no role and no name." Of line 5 it says: "It contains only an icon, so screen readers just announce 'button'", and the fix is aria-label="Delete".

expectations.text: The review flags blocked paste on the input and the destructive delete action without confirmation
expectations.evidence: The review says "Line 6: pasting into the filter is blocked", and also "Delete also runs straight away with no confirmation or undo", with the fix of putting a confirmation step or undo in front of onDelete.

expectations.text: The review flags the fixed toolbar using 100vh (dvh) and/or missing safe-area handling
expectations.evidence: The review flags "position: 'fixed', bottom: 0, height: '100vh'" and notes that "On mobile, `100vh` is also taller than the visible area". It suggests `height: '100dvh'`, though it does not mention safe-area handling.
